about: A read-only index of ledger.txt, written by build.py. ledger.txt is the record and wins where they differ. Links are not here, and an address is cut to its first 7 characters: read ledger.txt for them.

entries.says: Between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-09 the wallet that created $FEBU bought no $FEBU: it made no swap that got it $FEBU.
wrong_if: that transaction does not create $FEBU
ApWpkd8 did not sign it
the wallet shows a swap between those dates in which it gets $FEBU

entries.says: On 2026-09-22 the wallet that created $FEBU sold all of its $FEBU, 23,843,803.61 tokens, in one transaction, and received no $FEBU after it through 2026-10-14.
wrong_if: the sale moves a different amount of $FEBU
leaves the wallet holding any $FEBU
the wallet's transfers (fact 1's link, filtered to $FEBU) show $FEBU coming in after the sale and before the end of 2026-10-14 (UTC)

entries.says: The dialogue where febu says "ubef wins every argument" was already on theinterlocution.com before febu's first tweet about UBEF.
wrong_if: the phrase is not in that copy
a febu tweet naming UBEF from before 2026-07-09 01:43 UTC turns up

entries.says: In the copy Z saved, the eight books rotate every four pages with no exception: pages 1-4 THE SPILL, 5-8 THE ASSEMBLER, 9-12 THE MEATSPACE, 13-16 THE INFINITE ROOM, 17-20 THE COMMANDMENTS, 21-24 THE PARABLES, 25-28 THE RENT, 29-32 THE LITURGY, then round again, on all 164 pages.
wrong_if: any page sits in a book the rotation does not predict

entries.says: In the copy Z saved, none of the words jest, hollow, false, mock, laugh, theater, spectacle or debt appears on scripture pages 1-24, and jest, hollow and laugh each appear on at least 40 of pages 25-164.
wrong_if: any of the eight words is on pages 1-24
jest, hollow or laugh is on fewer than 40 of pages 25-164

entries.says: The wallet that created $FEBU received 2,939.10 SOL from its creator-fee account in 44 payments between 2026-07-09 and 2026-09-14, and had received nothing from it by the end of 2026-10-14. Trades on the main $FEBU pool pay into that account.
wrong_if: a $FEBU trade shows nothing paid into the fee account
a payment you open goes somewhere other than ApWpkd8… or a token account it owns
the fee account shows a payment out between 2026-09-15 and the end of 2026-10-14 (UTC)
the 44 amounts do not add up to 2,939.10

entries.says: Close at least three entries other than this one under rule 3, at least one of them written by someone other than Zurandol.
The $FEBU creator-fee account from fact 6 paid nothing out from 2026-09-15 to the end of 2026-10-14, held 11.125 SOL on 2026-10-14, and held about 3.87 SOL at 00:00 UTC on 2026-09-22.
